name: avonkannewurff-site
description: Personal site. Static HTML/CSS/JS with no build step — npm is only used to pin and refresh the vendored Three.js build.

scripts.vendor:three: npm install && cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.min.js node_modules/three/build/three.core.min.js vendor/ && sed "s|} from 'three';|} from './three.module.min.js';|" node_modules/three/examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js > vendor/RoundedBoxGeometry.js
